header.name: Verdant Bot 1.3.1 • Bedrock 1.21.114 • General Engines + Nether + Pathfinder
header.description: 1.3.1 GENERAL ENGINES - one architecture instead of per-case hardcoding. MOBS: core/mobs.js describes any entity by archetype (melee/brute/archer/bomber/leaper/teleporter/fire/flying/potion/summoner/heavy/boss/...), infers unknown and modded ids from name patterns and the engine's type_family, and exposes drops for the item graph. COMBAT: core/combat-plan.js plans real engagements from arithmetic - incoming dps, burst, time-to-die vs time-to-kill, kill order by damage-per-second-of-effort, surround detection, escape vectors - for any number of attackers; runtime/combat.js executes stances (engage/kite/shield_advance/cover/retreat/flee/tower) instead of 40 per-mob branches. RECIPES: core/recipe-book.js generates 263 recipes from families (every wood door/fence/trapdoor/bed colour, every tool and armour material) plus smelting, and an acquisition graph that plans bucket = logs -> planks -> table -> iron -> furnace -> smelt -> craft, hunts mob drops, and reports honest blocks. !bot recipe <item> prints the plan. SURVIVAL: core/needs.js ranks needs by severity (breathe, lava, burning, falling, suffocation, combat, heal, starving, exposure, darkness, tooling, unarmed, inventory, lost) with capability filtering, hysteresis and cooldowns; SurvivalMaster runs it before the legacy 80 scenarios, which stay as a backstop. Autonomous expedition director: !bot auto prepares and initiates Nether trips when readiness checks pass; inspect status, disable with !bot config nether off. Keeps 1.2.8 pathfinder + fully autonomous Nether travel (build/light/enter/link/return) and the 1.2.6/1.2.7 efficiency and speedrun work. 126 new offline tests (tools/general.test.mjs); the full suite passes.
